body.text: Adversarially replay ResourceMetabolism as the non-originating carrier. Required proofs: unchanged roughly 4 MiB inventory enters exponential yield backoff; a cached interval performs no inventory scan or DeletionProof write; changed inventory or at least 1 GiB of new pressure reopens maintenance; the hard emergency floor always overrides backoff; observation-time and free-space noise do not alter inventory identity. Return review_result or a minimal trace_divergence.

subject: Cross-provider review: attack yield-aware ExtremeGC backoff
